@role: Typed data movement, operator sequences, and lane bindings. Pipeline transforms.

@module_contract.note: Each pipeline stage references a block by atomic_id. The pipeline's own id IS its atomic_id — workflow nodes reference pipelines by this id.

phase_hooks.Pop: receive pipeline declaration; resolve pipeline.id as atomic_id
phase_hooks.Wo: bind typed input/output ports; wire stage references to block registry
phase_hooks.Yax: bind typed ports for each stage; propagate type constraints through the stage chain
phase_hooks.Sek: propose stage execution order; apply lane bindings; require XCFE admission
phase_hooks.Ch'en: verify type compatibility end-to-end; verify rank_effect contract holds across all stages
phase_hooks.Xul: emit validated pipeline; return typed port bindings

rank_effects.preserving: output type and rank identical to input
rank_effects.enriching: output carries additional fields but same base rank
rank_effects.reducing: output rank is strictly less than input (fold/reduce operators)
rank_effects.transforming: output type differs from input (map/filter/stack operators)

xcfe.note: Pipeline proposes stage order. XCFE authorizes execution of each stage individually.

@control.@desc: receive pipeline declaration; bind pipeline.id as atomic_id

@args: Wo: pipeline bindings — id=$pipeline_id stages=$stages.length rank=$rank_effect

@control.@desc: resolve TypedPort for each stage boundary; propagate type constraints
apply lane bindings; resolve parallel stage groups; require XCFE admission per stage
confirm type compatibility chain; confirm rank_effect contract holds end-to-end
emit PipelineResult; return typed port bindings
